reportsPageDescription: Generate and review the Article 6.2 Agreed Electronic Format (AEF) tables for the selected reporting year.
noSubmission: No submission record for this reporting year
exportFailed: Could not download the report. Please try again.
provisional: Provisional — as at today, not a year-end snapshot
carpPopulatedHint: This field is populated by the CARP and must be left empty on submission.
submitAefLate: Annual information for this reporting year was due by {{date}}.
submitAefAdvisory: Submitting records the filing date and marks the year as submitted. It does not lock the data — later edits will not be reflected in what has already been filed with the CARP.
submitAefBlocked: This year cannot be submitted yet — the following issues must be resolved first:
dateOfSubmissionFootnote: The date the AEF is filed. Empty until submission — it is not knowable when the record is created.
reviewStatusOfInitialReport: REVIEW STATUS OF THE INITIAL REPORT
resultOfConsistencyCheck: RESULT OF THE CONSISTENCY CHECK OF THIS AEF SUBMISSION
ndcFirstYear: FIRST YEAR OF THE NDC IMPLEMENTATION PERIOD
ndcLastYear: LAST YEAR OF THE NDC IMPLEMENTATION PERIOD
referenceToTerReport: REFERENCE TO THE ARTICLE 6 TECHNICAL EXPERT REVIEW REPORT
authorizedQuantityFootnote: Optional. The maximum quantity of mitigation outcomes authorized for use towards an NDC and/or OIMP.
authorizedPartyIdsFootnote: Where the authorization is limited to a specific Party or Parties, their unique identifiers.
authorizedEntityIdsFootnote: Unique identifier of the entities that are authorized, if applicable.
oimpAuthorizedFootnote: Only applicable if the authorization is for OIMP. The specific purpose, for example use under CORSIA.
authorizedTimeframeFootnote: Optional. The timeframe in which mitigation outcomes may occur and/or be used, as 'dddd - dddd'.
firstTransferDefinitionOimpFootnote: Only applicable to authorizations for OIMP use. The Party's first transfer definition under decision 2/CMA.3, annex, para. 2(b).
actionDateFootnote: Date on which the action was executed in the Party ITMO registry. ISO 8601 with a zero UTC offset.
firstIdFootnote: First unique identifier of the ITMO block, per decision 6/CMA.4, annex I, para. 5.
lastIdFootnote: Last unique identifier of the ITMO block. Blocks from the same registry must not overlap.
underlyingUnitRegistryFootnote: The underlying cooperative approach registry. Reported as 'NA' if the approach does not use one.
gwpValuesFootnote: Where non-CO2 greenhouse gases are involved, the global warming potential values applied.
nonGhgMetricFootnote: Type of non-GHG metric applied. Reported as 'NA' if the ITMOs are in a GHG metric.
quantityNonGhgFootnote: Quantity in the respective non-GHG metric. Reported as 'NA' if the ITMOs are in a GHG metric.
transferringPartyFootnote: Only applicable to the action type 'acquisition'. Otherwise reported as 'NA'.
acquiringPartyFootnote: Applicable to the action types 'first transfer' and 'transfer'. Otherwise reported as 'NA'.
usingCancellingPartyFootnote: Only applicable to report a use for IMP or a cancellation for OP.
usingCancellingEntityFootnote: Only applicable where an authorized entity uses or cancels the ITMOs.
purposeItmoUsedForOimp: PURPOSE FOR WHICH THE ITMO HAS BEEN USED TOWARDS OR CANCELLED FOR OIMP
purposeItmoUsedForOimpFootnote: Only applicable to the action types 'use', 'first transfer' and 'cancellation'.
yearItmoUsedTowardsNdc: CALENDAR YEAR FOR WHICH THE ITMOs ARE USED TOWARDS THE PARTY'S NDC
yearItmoUsedTowardsNdcFootnote: Only applicable for use of ITMOs towards the Party's NDC.
identificationNumberFootnote: Identification number in the country of incorporation.
entityConditionsFootnote: Optional. The conditions under which the authorization was provided.
entityChangeConditionsFootnote: Optional. Whether the authorization may be changed or revoked, and under which conditions.
